purpose: Project the final LBE product plan as one persistent provider-neutral governed agent lifecycle. UI, guard packs, Cline mechanics, external integrations and historical clients are subordinate capabilities or projections, not separate product architectures.
authority_rule: Before every project decision or next-step instruction, recall the final LBE product goal, refresh current GPT-K plan/status/handoff/canonical execution path, then inspect current evidence. GPT-K is a projection; current canonical repository/runtime/governance evidence remains implementation truth.
final_product_goal: A local persistent LBE agent that can start or resume a workspace/session, reason with a selected provider, discover and request governed capabilities, execute only through LBE authorization and registered adapters, consume ToolReceipts/evidence, replan across turns, deterministically validate completion, persist/recover state, and expose the same lifecycle through whichever existing client surface reaches correct manual acceptance fastest without creating a second authority.
core_invariant: Agent/provider owns cognition; LBE owns capabilities and consequences.

lifecycle_plan.required_product_behavior: Resolve canonical workspace, persisted session, provider/model/profile, mode/policy and installed capabilities; create or restore exactly one product session.
Assemble bounded current workspace/project context and evidence without replacing agent reasoning with a fixed LBE cognitive workflow.
Agent independently chooses investigation strategy, capabilities and next actions; structured ReasoningPlan remains optional/specialist rather than mandatory product cognition.

Every authority-bearing capability request passes through existing policy/R6C authorization and R6E ToolRegistry/GovernedToolOrchestrator; execution returns one correlated ToolReceipt/evidence record.
Registered evidence producers and deterministic completion owners evaluate outcome; provider prose cannot establish terminal completion truth.
Persist session/task state, runtime events, receipts, evidence, recovery/checkpoint state and only evidence-gated validated memory/completion truth.
Agent consumes receipts/evidence, replans or completes; LBE preserves identity, authority boundaries, cancellation/recovery and resume across turns/restarts.
